Hostopia's white-label Reputation & Listing Management gives your customers one place to publish listings, respond to reviews with AI, and benchmark against local competitors — so they show up consistently, credibly, and in control.

features.heading: Reputation That Drives Revenue
features.intro: Built for partners who want SMB customers to look credible everywhere buyers check. Every feature is engineered to protect and grow reputation without adding hours to the owner's week.

cards.title: AI Review Responses
cards.body: On-brand replies drafted in seconds across Google, Meta, and other review platforms. Owners approve and post with one tap — or let AI auto-respond within brand-safe rules.

cards.title: Competitive Reputation Intelligence
cards.body: See review volume, ratings, sentiment, and response time benchmarked against local competitors — with AI-driven insights on where to focus first.

cards.title: 30+ Directory Sync
cards.body: Publish once and appear everywhere that matters. Google, Meta, and 30+ local directories stay consistent and current from a single control panel.

cards.title: AI Social Content & Scheduling
cards.body: Generate, schedule, and publish on-brand social posts across major platforms. Stay visible between reviews, promotions, and campaigns without hiring a copywriter.

cards.title: Centralized Reputation Control
cards.body: One dashboard for reviews, listings, social, and benchmarking. One login, one source of truth, zero platform-hopping for busy owners.

cards.title: Automated Workflows
cards.body: Route reviews to the right staff, trigger follow-ups, and escalate critical feedback automatically — so nothing slips through and every customer feels heard.

partnerAdvantage.heading: Reputation Is the Retention Play
partnerAdvantage.intro: Reputation management solves a problem every SMB has and almost none solve well — which makes it one of the stickiest, highest-margin products you can add to your portfolio.

items.title: Address a critical SMB pain point
items.body: Every local business worries about reviews and listings, and most have no system to manage them. You become the partner who finally makes it easy — and the one they won't switch away from.

items.title: High retention value
items.body: Reputation data compounds. The longer a customer uses the product, the more historical insights, automated replies, and competitive benchmarks they lose by leaving. Churn drops. Lifetime value climbs.

items.title: Differentiation with advanced AI features
items.body: AI review responses, sentiment analysis, and competitive intelligence position you as a premium digital partner — not another reseller of basic utilities.

items.title: Easy set-up and integration
items.body: Fast onboarding, connector-based integrations, and a white-label experience mean customers see value in minutes and your support team spends less time on deployment.
